title.narrative: Promoting Sustainable Public-Private Partnerships Program (Subprogram 1)

description.narrative: The proposed program supports the Government of Pakistan's efforts to promote sustainable, broad-based, and inclusive economic growth. The core objective of the program is to strengthen the governance framework and enabling environment for publicprivate partnerships (PPPs) at the federal government level by strengthening the (i) policy, legal, and institutional frameworks for public investment management and public financial management in connection with PPPs; and (ii) national and sectoral infrastructure planning and PPP project preparation. The program is designed as a policy-based loan with a programmatic approach and two subprograms. Subprogram 1 aims to improve the policies, laws, and institutional capacity that provide the foundation for creating an enabling environment for PPPs. Subprogram 2 will build on these foundational actions to operationalize the PPP framework and, ultimately, prepare a sustainable pipeline of well-structured and fiscally prudent PPP projects. The program was requested by the Government of Pakistan as a policy-based lending modality to be disbursed over two subprograms. The PBL will facilitate the design and implementation of reforms that are necessary to create an enabling environment for PPPs. The programmatic approach will serve to chronologically sequence the reforms in a multiyear framework (2022-2024) and bring flexibility to incorporate changes as warranted by the country's economic situation.

title.narrative: Policy 1 Outcome 1 Implementation Period: Sep 01, 2022 - Jun 30, 2024

description.narrative:
Action 1: To align the PPP process with the public investment management framework, the Parliament has approved amendments to the Public Private Partnership Authority Act, 2017 to: (i) introduce the role of the Central Development Working Party and Executive Committee of National Economic Council for approval of PPP projects;b and (ii) clarify the role of the P3A Board for approval of project concept proposals. Target date: 2024-06-30
Action 2: For implementation of the Public Private Partnership Authority Act, 2017, the P3A Board has approved the following secondary legislation: (i) viability gap funding regulations; (ii) project development facility regulations; and (iii) qualified project criteria regulations. Target date: 2024-06-30
Action 3: In order to enhance the institutional design and effectiveness of PPPs as part of the public investment management process, the Federal cabinet has approved the action plan under the 2023 Public Investment Management Assessment and the Climate Public Investment Management Assessment. Target date: 2024-06-30
Action 4: In order to strengthen P3A's institutional framework to achieve its strategic objectives, P3A has developed and adopted a gender sensitive and climate responsive business strategy for 2023-2027 with specific performance indicators to undertake the P3A's climate commitments, and has commenced implementation of: (i) Human resources regulations and organizational chart to effectively deliver on the organization's operational priorities; and (ii) Gender, diversity, and inclusion policy that includes a target of at least 25 percent of female staff within five years, assurance for equal opportunity employment, and a consistent rewards and remuneration package across genders. Target date: 2024-06-30
Action 5: To ensure that the planning, development, and operation of PPP projects is environmentally sustainable and socially responsible, P3A has approved the environmental and social safeguards management system by the integration of environmental, social, gender, and climate risk screening into project preparation and approval, and addressing gender issues in environmental and social management. Target date: 2024-06-30
Action 6: In order to strengthen the government's institutional capacity to safeguard overall fiscal and public debt sustainability, the government has established a risk management unit within the Finance Division to assess fiscal risks and contingent liabilities, emanating from PPPs, with approved staffing plan. Target date: 2024-06-30
Action 7: The Finance Division has issued guidelines for fiscal risk assessment of individual PPP projects including analysis, control, budgeting, and reporting of direct and contingent liabilities for effective fiscal risk management. Target date: 2024-06-30
Action 1: To strengthen the legal framework for PPPs, the P3A Board will approve secondary legislation, including regulations and guidelines for mediation and settlement of disputes, and treatment of unsolicited proposals and institutional PPPs. Target date: 2025-12-31

title.narrative: Policy 1 Outcome 5 Implementation Period: Jul 01, 2024 - Dec 31, 2025

description.narrative:
Policy 1: Reform Area 1: Strengthening legal and institutional frameworks for public investment management and public financial management for PPPs NA
Action 2: To promote private sector participation in climate and disaster resilient infrastructure projects, the government will adopt guidelines for resilient infrastructure PPPs, and initiate their implementation. Target date: 2025-12-31
Action 3: To fully operationalize P3A's operational capacity, P3A will recruit and deploy adequately skilled staff, at least 10% of whom are women, according to the approved organizational chart. Target date: 2025-12-31
Action 4: To strengthen institutional arrangements for PPP development (including planning, implementation, and execution), the government will establish PPP nodes or appoint dedicated and skilled staff in at least three line ministries or agencies to develop, execute, and implement PPP projects. Target date: 2025-12-31
Action 5: To ensure that the planning, development, and operation of PPP projects is environmentally sustainable and socially responsible, P3A will operationalize environment, social, gender, and climate risk screening into project preparation by adopting and implementing an environment and social management system. Target date: 2025-12-31
Action 6: To strengthen the government's institutional capacity to safeguard overall fiscal and public debt sustainability, the government will operationalize the fiscal risk management unit by appointing full-time staff in accordance with the approved staffing plan. Target date: 2025-12-31
Action 7: To mitigate exposure to fiscal risks stemming from PPPs, the Finance Division will: (i) approve a fit-for-purpose fiscal risk assessment tool, (ii) quantify the macro-fiscal implications of PPPs utilizing the approved assessment tool, evaluating the risks assumed by government, and identifying and reporting potential direct and contingent liabilities under the debt sustainability analysis. Target date: 2025-12-31
Action 1: The Federal cabinet has approved an integrated PPP policy, to promote policy and regulatory consistency, increase awareness, and identify and align sectoral priorities with public investment program, and enhance public and private sector participation in implementation of updated NDCs and promote climate change mitigation and adaptation measures in PPP projects developed and implemented by the Federal Government. (Documents required: extract of the Federal cabinet approval for the PPP policy along with the approved policy). Target date: 2024-06-30

(Documents required: evidence of accounts opening and budget allocation in the annual budget) Target date: 2024-06-30
